output.summary: Long-lived coniferous tree native to eastern North America, from Nova Scotia and southeastern Ontario south through the Appalachians to western North Carolina and eastern Tennessee. It has a narrow conical crown, sharp four-sided yellow-green needles and hanging glossy red-brown cones, and young trees tolerate deep shade.
output.edibilityNote: Leafy twigs are boiled with sugar and flavoring to make spruce beer or spruce pudding.
